Container.Name: VoidLLM
Container.Overview: Privacy-first LLM proxy and AI gateway. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint in front of vLLM, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock and other providers, with load balancing, multi-provider routing, API key management, usage tracking, rate limiting and an MCP gateway. Self-hosted, zero knowledge of your prompts.[br][br] [b]First start:[/b] Set an Encryption Key and an Admin Key (generate both with [code]openssl rand -base64 32[/code]). On the first start VoidLLM prints the UI login (email + password) and your first API key ([code]vl_uk_...[/code]) to the container log, exactly once. Open the log right after starting and save them.[br][br] [b]Important:[/b] Never change the Encryption Key after the first start, otherwise all stored upstream API keys become unreadable.[br][br] Models and providers can be managed in the web UI. For advanced setups place a [code]voidllm.yaml[/code] in the config folder (see voidllm.yaml.example in the project repository). An empty config folder is fine.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: llm ai gateway proxy openai ollama vllm anthropic claude chatgpt api-keys mcp litellm
Container.Requires: The container runs as user 99:100 (nobody:users). If the container log shows a permission error for /data, run [code]chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/voidllm[/code] once in the Unraid terminal.

Config.Name: WebUI / API Port
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible proxy (/v1), web UI, admin API and health checks (/healthz, /readyz).

Config.Name: Admin Port (optional)
Config.Description: Separate port for admin API and UI. Only active if server.admin.port is set to 8443 in voidllm.yaml. Unused by default.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database with users, keys and usage data. Without this volume everything is lost when the container is recreated.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Optional. Put voidllm.yaml (and voidllm.license.jwt for Enterprise) here. Leave the folder empty to run with defaults and manage everything in the UI.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Required. AES-256 key for stored upstream API keys, 32 bytes base64. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Set once, NEVER change it afterwards.

Config.Name: Admin Key
Config.Description: Bootstrap key (min. 32 characters), only used on the first start with an empty database to create the first admin. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. The real login and vl_uk_ API key appear once in the container log.

Config.Name: License (Enterprise)
Config.Description: Optional Enterprise license JWT. Leave empty for the free edition.
